rows.exactSource: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access.
rows.candidate: Mvelaphanḓa a yo ngo kona u laisiwa kana u vhulungwa. Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu kana account access yaṋu.
rows.literalBackTranslation: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access.
rows.reason: Uses the existing Tshivenda progress term mvelaphanḓa, the existing load verb laisa (“Ho kundelwa u laisa data”), and save term vhulunga. It preserves both failure modes and the connection/account-access recovery choices.
rows.risk: The passive form laisiwa is derived from the existing load verb but needs Tshivenda grammar review. “account access” remains a technical loan.

rows.candidate: Slides + ṱhalutshedzo nga ipfi ya English source na clips
rows.literalBackTranslation: Slides + English source narration and clips.
rows.reason: The UI presents this as an explicit full-pack choice alongside the slides-only default for learners whose selected-language narration is not exact. The full-pack note says available English source narration; naming English source avoids implying regional-language narration.
rows.risk: Keep the technical terms and plus-list scope clear; do not shorten this to generic narration or imply every regional deck has a local voice.

rows.reason: This is the heading immediately above the lesson quiz. Ṱolani (“check”) is anchored by current Tshivenda UI phrases such as “Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu”; it does not reuse Xitsonga Kambela.
rows.risk: The noun construction u pfesesa haṋu is a draft without a matching existing locale key; verify the Tshivenda word/form for understanding.

rows.candidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi yo fhela
rows.literalBackTranslation: Mark that this module is finished/complete.
rows.reason: Uses Tshivenda Tshwaya (“mark”) already in the locale and the same fhela completion state used by accepted studentComplete/studentDone labels. The context is a module progress toggle.
rows.risk: The completion pair needs a fluent grammar check; fhela can describe finishing, so confirm that the surrounding “mark” verb clearly makes this a progress-state action.

rows.candidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi a yo ngo fhela
rows.literalBackTranslation: Mark that this module is not finished/complete.
rows.reason: Pairs the positive done-state draft with explicit negation, without adding “yet.” This aria label appears only when the module is currently marked done and the action will undo that state.
rows.risk: Confirm negative concord and that the phrase communicates unmarking completion rather than a claim about whether work has ever been attempted.
